note: Median of 7 kernel-assembly samples measured on a quiet machine via LODE_PERF_MEASURE=1 xcodebuild test -project Lode.xcodeproj -scheme Lode -only-testing:LodeTests/LaunchBudgetGateTests/testMeasureAssemblyBaseline. The gate allows 2x this value locally when idle; a busy-spin CPU probe detects scheduler contention (probe median > 5ms) and relaxes the local tolerance to 5x so concurrent builds do not trip the gate. Shared CI runners always use a flat 20x tolerance because hosted macOS runners show 3x-10x contention noise; CI only guards against gross assembly regressions while developer machines enforce the tighter local budget. Regenerate deliberately on a quiet machine and commit the new value with justification when the measurement environment changes.
